Before discharge, the only treatment provided in the wetlands is pH adjustment, as needed.
Until 2018, the 0.6-acre unlined pond was used as a sludge lagoon to store and process digested sludge.

The Facility utilizes two dedicated unlined emergency storage ponds; Emergency Storage Pond 1 and Emergency Storage Pond 2. Emergency Storage Pond 2 receives primary, secondary, and tertiary effluent from the facility but cannot be fully drained.
Two unlined recycled water storage ponds receive tertiary treated, disinfected effluent.
